title: Demonic Tower Hell Dimension 2024
author: kielrgz

scanner.why: boss_door, boss_door_use look like easter-egg state (map's own, after subtracting 827 stock names); confirm which combination means 'done'

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Hello everyone, it’s been a long time since I made a custom so here I bring one that I made. I thank Lava Will , Klaudeh and many more people who helped me make the map possible through scripting issues. The map was also tested so luckily it works fine! Hope you like. The context is that it is a generic tower as always but with some changes, I was going to do something like with another mechanic, medieval castle style and all that but currently this year I am focused on other things and I didn’t have time to do something better. The next map I will bring will be a Minecraft one so I hope that when I release it you will enjoy it a lot! and this one too obviously! Greetings to all. If you have any problems, let me know! If you play for Plutonium the sky will look black.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). The scanner found easter-egg state; WHICH combination means done is a human's call, so the finish is {"manual": true} and the Round 20 fallback applies meanwhile. PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
